record.where: The fairness pass (v3.31 — four field verdicts, answered at the root); its Proof line shared with the delivery ledgers
record.count_text: pinned by fairness.mjs — ten checks that measure the WORLD, not the code's opinion of it

clauses.text: Now: 118 on the flat

figure.note: a knife covers 118 px (±0.6) in one second of the world's step on flat meadow, and the tuning row reads 118

clauses.text: taxed by the SAME terrain and slope the player pays
a leash at 720, a stall-giveup

figure.note: a knife 700 off still runs and one 730 off breaks off without a step; 720 itself is not sampled

clauses.text: and the mounted law — a runner who sees the gap growing under hooves calls it ("A horse. Forget it.") and stops burning your attention
Proof: mounted gap 150→613 px in 3.5 s with the give-up line

figure.note: the gap starts at exactly 150 and must pass 550 in 3.5 s, wider at every step; the frozen page measures 576 — 613 itself is not pinned

clauses.text: on foot, light-and-sprinting pulls away while loaded-and-walking stays honestly caught
no relative-speed cheat anywhere
a sane load WALKING steep ground never rings; the hill's price is breath and pace
Proof with the wobble LIVE (the calm debug flag explicitly cleared — the earlier green here was vacuous and is called out as such): sixteen seconds on 0.32+ slope, ZERO rings

figure.note: 160 steps of 0.1 s, every one of them on ground of slope 0.32 or more, zero rings

clauses.text: overloaded on the same ground, the ring still comes
The ring now needs a REASON: overloaded past 1.0, sprinting on rough ground, fear, or empty lungs

figure.note: the overloaded trial reads a load of 1.12 and rings; the fear, lungs and sprint trials and the sane walk after read 0.54 (ringing only for their own reason, the sane walk not at all); 1.0 itself is not sampled

clauses.text: Water and rungs still dismount the rider — the horse has an opinion — but the horse now WANTS back on: it auto-remounts the far side of the obstacle with no button, no spook lockout, one quiet line the first time.
A CHOSEN dismount (R) stays dismounted — the automation serves the balk only and never overrides the player.
Proof: a routed ladder crossing sampled at 100 ms — crossed, max step NINE pixels

figure.note: a step on the rungs is held to nine (measured 7.3) and every step of the crossing to 11.5 (measured 9.8): nine is not held off the rungs

clauses.text: the snap math exact on a real placed ladder
the convoy junior closing 200+ px with every stride bounded under 60

figure.record: 200+ px with every stride bounded under 60
figure.note: the junior closes 200 px or more and no stride reaches 60

clauses.text: escortSnap (the convoy junior "sucked to your back") is DELETED
trudging at half pace when left behind (never frozen, never warped)

figure.note: the trudge is held under 0.6 of the junior's own speed (measured 59 of 118); half itself is not pinned

clauses.text: the companion catch-up teleport (300 px behind for 7 s = appear at your boots) is replaced by a visible run that closes any gap in seconds on their own legs

figure.note: the old teleport's trigger: a companion left 600 behind runs the gap shut stride by bounded stride inside the old 7 s mark; the 300/7 s rule itself is not sampled
